basics.name: Salih Abdullah Kilic
basics.label: Data Management, Data Engineering and SAS Consulting Specialist
basics.summary: I am a data management, data engineering and SAS consulting specialist. For enterprise clients in telecom, energy, insurance, retail and fintech, I take part in SAS 9.4 and SAS Viya migrations, data warehouse transformations, and performance tuning and data quality work. I develop SQL and ETL on Oracle, Hadoop, Vertica, PostgreSQL and similar data platforms. I also work on AI automations and AI-driven transformations, where I orchestrate agents, add AI to existing ETL processes and build KVKK-compliant custom LLM assistants and chatbots without sharing company data.

work.name: Sade Yazılım ve Danışmanlık
work.summary: SAS and data management consulting, technical support and project delivery for enterprise clients in energy, telecom, finance and insurance, retail and e-commerce, and the public sector.
highlights: Take part in SAS migration and modernization projects from SAS 9.4 and SAS Viya 3.5 to SAS Viya 4.
Develop and tune SQL and ETL processes on Oracle, Hadoop and Vertica, and work on data warehouse transformations.
Use AI agents and custom LLM assistants in this work, without sharing company data.

projects.name: Allianz: Oracle data warehouse transformation
projects.summary: In the migration from a legacy database schema to a Kimball star schema, I transform the models and reports that need converting to Oracle, in line with the new standards.
highlights: Tune and optimize SQL on Oracle.
Carry out the transformation with automation and support business units in adopting the new processes.
projects.short: In the migration from a legacy database schema to a Kimball star schema, I transform models and reports to Oracle in line with the new standards and tune and optimize SQL.

projects.name: Yves Rocher France: SAS Viya 4 migration
projects.summary: Contributed to the SAS Viya 4 migration of a large cosmetics retailer, moving legacy analytical assets to a modern architecture.
highlights: Converted 5 Enterprise Guide projects and their SAS code to SAS Studio, and moved selected Enterprise Miner models to Viya Model Studio.
Supported the conversion of 72 Visual Data Builder flows to SAS Studio Flows and the migration of 116 Visual Analytics reports to SAS Viya 4.
Optimized the data pipelines that feed the machine-learning models.
Delivered part of the 10 days of on-the-job training.
projects.short: Moved 5 Enterprise Guide projects, 72 data flows and 116 Visual Analytics reports to SAS Viya 4 and delivered part of the client training.

projects.name: Türk Telekom: SAS Viya 4 consulting, optimization and support
projects.summary: Following the SAS Viya 4 migration, provided maintenance, technical support, model optimization, multi-platform integrations and SAS consulting in line with business unit requests.
highlights: Optimized and troubleshot existing analytical models, and advised business units on SAS best practices.
Set up and supported Git/Bitbucket, VS Code, MCP and SAS SDK integrations for effective use of Viya modules.
Enabled multi-platform workflows combining SAS Viya with Python, SQL, Oracle and Hadoop.
projects.short: Post-migration, delivered model optimization, troubleshooting and SAS best-practice consulting; set up Git/Bitbucket, VS Code, MCP and SAS SDK integrations for multi-platform workflows with Python, SQL, Oracle and Hadoop.

projects.name: Türk Telekom: SAS Viya 3.5 to SAS Viya 4 transformation
projects.summary: Worked in the Data Management team of one of the largest telecommunications providers in Türkiye, moving analytical workloads to the Kubernetes-based SAS Viya 4.
highlights: Managed the end-to-end migration of analytical models and reports for the Corporate and Fixed business units, and contributed to the Mobile and Digital units.
Wrote a regex-based Python program that analyzed more than 70,000 Oracle and Hadoop tables to find which were in use and how models depended on them.
Designed partitioning strategies for Hadoop and Oracle tables for high-performance data processing.
Adapted analytical workflows to the microservices architecture of SAS Viya 4.
projects.short: Migrated the models and reports of two business units from SAS Viya 3.5 to Viya 4 end to end, analyzed 70,000+ Oracle and Hadoop tables with a self-written Python program and designed partitioning strategies.

projects.name: Enerjisa: SAS 9.4 to SAS Viya modernization
projects.summary: Took part in the modernization and migration from SAS 9.4 to SAS Viya for a large Turkish utilities organization.

Developed, optimized and tested data exchange between Oracle, Vertica, SAP S/4HANA and AWS, scheduled with Apache Airflow.
